repos.name: open-webui/open-webui
repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.one_liner: A feature-rich, self-hosted web interface for LLMs that supports Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
bullets: Built with Python and Svelte for a responsive, desktop-like AI interaction experience.
Supports RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and multi-modal model integration.
Designed for enterprise-grade deployment with robust role-based access control and authentication.
Ideal for teams building internal AI tools or private LLM-powered knowledge bases.

repos.name: richiemcilroy/Tov
repos.description: A TypeScript-shaped language built for coding agents. It compiles to small, fast native binaries.
repos.one_liner: A TypeScript-shaped programming language specifically engineered for AI coding agents.
bullets: Compiles to small, high-performance native binaries for efficient agent execution.
Syntax optimized for LLM reasoning, reducing token overhead and hallucination risks.
Focuses on type safety and deterministic behavior in automated coding workflows.
Targeted at developers building the next generation of autonomous software engineering agents.

repos.name: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
repos.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive harness providing free access to advanced coding models like Claude Code and Codex.
bullets: Aggregates multiple AI coding harnesses into a single terminal and IDE-integrated interface.
Enables high-volume development tasks by leveraging over 1.3 billion free tokens.
Supports native browser sessions, allowing agents to interact with web-based environments.
Essential for developers looking to scale agentic workflows without incurring high API costs.

repos.name: onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent
repos.description: Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32: AirPlay eyes, USB HID hands, any OpenAI-compatible vision model. No developer account, no Xcode, no jailbreak.
repos.one_liner: An innovative hardware-software bridge allowing AI agents to control a physical iPhone via an ESP32.
bullets: Uses a $7 ESP32 microcontroller to simulate USB HID inputs and AirPlay visual feedback.
Enables agentic control of mobile apps without requiring jailbreaks or developer accounts.
Compatible with any OpenAI-compatible vision model for real-time screen analysis.
Pioneers a new category of physical-world automation for mobile-first fintech or productivity testing.

repos.name: NVIDIA-Omniverse/usd-brep
repos.description: USD BRep is a standalone C++ and Python library for NURBS-based boundary representation (BRep) solid modeling
repos.one_liner: A high-performance C++ and Python library for NURBS-based boundary representation solid modeling.
bullets: Provides robust infrastructure for precise 3D geometry processing within the USD ecosystem.
Supports complex BRep operations essential for CAD/CAM and industrial digital twin applications.
Optimized for integration into large-scale simulation and visualization pipelines.
Critical for professionals working in infrastructure modeling, manufacturing, or high-fidelity simulation.
